comment: The panel groups the fifteen step jacks into five rows tagged 1, 2, 5, 7 and 12, with an up arrow, a down arrow and a zigzag over the three columns; the two reset jacks are lettered NOTE and LOGIC, and the edge switch KILL above and WRAP below. The edge output is the one port the maker did not name. The Range knob's displayed figure is the whole band: src/Simmer.cpp:95 halves the knob and line 128 compares against half of that again, so a reading of 4 volts keeps the pitch between -1V and +1V.
